name: vaquill/resolve
description: Resolve up to 50 Bluebook citation strings to the exact US law sections they name.

state.description: Lowercase two-letter jurisdiction to resolve the whole batch within, for forms several states share ('8 CCR 1206-2' is Colorado, '22 CCR 76227' California). Omit for a batch that spans jurisdictions.

citations.description: Bluebook citations to resolve, e.g. ['42 U.S.C. 1983', '16 C.F.R. 444.1', 'Cal. Civ. Code 1950.5']. Duplicates are collapsed; at most 50 distinct citations per call. A pinpoint such as '42 U.S.C. 1983(b)(2)' resolves to the parent section and is echoed back in subsection.

corpusType.description: Corpus to resolve the whole batch within: STATE (statutory text), REGULATION (administrative codes), STATE_RULES (court rules), CONSTITUTION / STATE_CONSTITUTION.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.

readme:
# Vaquill Resolve

Resolve up to 50 Bluebook citation strings to the exact US law sections they name.

## Pricing

- Inspect reference unit price: $0.02 USD per result.
- Final settlement uses the provider-reported actual cost after strict validation; the reference price is not used to infer the final charge.
